SELECT T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.ACCOUNT AS account, T1.ASSET_ID AS assetId, T1.HOLD_QTY_AMOUNT AS holdQtyAmount, T1.HOLD_SHARES AS holdShares, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark, T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_PRODUCTS_ASSET_COMPARE T1
1=1
and T1.DATE_STATUS = STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStatus}, '%Y-%m-%d')

select T1.ACCOUNT AS account, T1.TOTALSHARES AS totalShares, T2.TOTAL_AMT AS totalAmt FROM (select ACCOUNT, sum(HOLD_QTY_AMOUNT) TOTALSHARES from CHB_PRODUCTS_ASSET_COMPARE where 1=1
and DATE_STATUS = STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStatus}, '%Y-%m-%d')
group by ACCOUNT)T1 left join CHB_FINANCE_PRODUCTS_SUB T2 on T1.ACCOUNT=T2.PROD_ID where 1=1
and T2.DATE_STATUS = STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStatus}, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHB_PRODUCTS_ASSET_COMPARE
1=1
and DATE_STATUS = STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStatus}, '%Y-%m-%d')
select * from chb_subinfo_batch_log where task_id=#{taskId} and deal_status = '04'
